hideAIOverview.title: Hide Google AI Overviews
hideAIOverview.description: When true, immediately hides Google AI Overview modules in standard Google Search results and keeps a DOM-based fallback active.

blockAIMode.title: Block Google AI Mode
blockAIMode.description: When true, hides AI Mode entry points and redirects AI Mode URLs back to Google Search.

forceWebMode.title: Force Google Web mode
forceWebMode.description: When true, standard Google Search requests are redirected to the Web results view using udm=14. Existing non-AI search modes such as Images are left alone.
